treatments.title: Small Core
treatments.logline: What if your agent were small? pi splits the monolith into a tiny core and the plugins you choose.
treatments.metaphor: a heavy monolith slab that cracks into modular tiles orbiting a tiny core
treatments.motif: square tiles on a strict grid — the same tile becomes plugin, counter cell and cursor

scenes.name: monolith
scenes.idea: A huge slab labelled AGENT fills the grid and presses down; the question types across it.
on_screen: What if your agent were small?

scenes.name: core_split
scenes.idea: The slab cracks along grid lines; tiles fly out and settle in orbit around a tiny core square marked pi; each tile gets a plugin label.

scenes.name: tile_tally
scenes.idea: Tiles rain into a 68-cell grid (one per extension example) while two side tallies count docs pages and keybindings.

scenes.name: adapt_line
scenes.idea: The tiles rearrange into the shape of the viewer's own workflow as the README line lands.
on_screen: Adapt Pi to your workflow, not the other way around.

scenes.name: install_end
scenes.idea: One tile becomes a blinking cursor; the npm command types out; pi.dev and the version.

treatments.title: Five Doors
treatments.logline: A little lamp-headed courier visits the five doors of pi — interactive, print, JSON, RPC, SDK — counting down to install.
treatments.metaphor: a small street of five doors, each a mode of the same agent, visited in a countdown
treatments.motif: a warm lamp carried from door to door

scenes.name: door_street
scenes.idea: Tracking shot past five doors numbered 5 to 1; each opens on its mode.

scenes.name: lamp_room
scenes.idea: Inside: shelves of 68 small jars — the extension examples.

scenes.name: lamp_out
scenes.idea: The courier sets the lamp in the window: pi.dev.

treatments.title: 278 Releases Deep
treatments.logline: A walkthrough down a mine shaft of 278 releases to the small core at the bottom.
treatments.metaphor: a vertical shaft of stacked release strata, descended by an elevator
treatments.motif: an elevator light descending through strata

scenes.name: shaft_descent
scenes.idea: Camera descends through 278 thin strata labelled by month.

scenes.name: core_room
scenes.idea: At the bottom: the tiny core with plugins wired in.

scenes.name: shaft_up
scenes.idea: Elevator rises with the install command.
